title: Silent-Partner File
warm:

[player_name]—early thirties, she/her, neighbor across the hall—stood in the Crownspire penthouse with Layer 7 pressure already rewriting soft into sharper ink. The locked drawer from the night before had become an open mouth. Detective Imani Brooks's homicide interest rose downstairs without a body. Four fates still open: willing leave, paid vanish, dead, staging.

"This is how absence used to be purchased," Nolan said. Mid-forties, finance and tech holding, brutal charm never clean-cut. His cufflinks clicked once—the tell that lived when Vivienne's name entered a room—and then went still. "Not proof she used it. Not proof she didn't. Soft alibi still keeps you from becoming Brooks's sharpest edge. Soft also means you stop pretending paper doesn't rhyme."

[player_name] lifted a sheet and felt her throat close. Calendar gaps weekly to monthly to gone lived beside silent-partner method like cousins at a funeral that might still be a vacation. She did not invent death. She did not invent willing leave. The file only proved Nolan knew how to make someone gone in a way money preferred—and that Vivienne's cadence could be read as method or coincidence depending on which fear you fed.

Wind sheer pressed floor-to-ceiling glass. Elevator chime trembled in the private shaft. Somewhere below, Rhea Quinn was choosing how much slate to surrender; somewhere in a black car, Pell was polishing traveling until it reflected nothing. Across the hall, [player_name]'s apartment waited with clearer conscience and colder sheets.

"You can name the old absence method publicly," Nolan said, almost kind, "and watch the holding burn. Or you can bargain with Pell—seal what you saw, spend soft into quieter teeth. Neither settles Vivienne. Both spend us."

She catalogued the file the way Brooks would: paper, dates, methods, no settled corpse. Soft alibi had fingerprints now. Hope and dread shared the wine ring on marble. Unused perfume still breathed from the master bath she should not know. Soft cooperation had stopped being temporary the moment silent-partner ink learned her name.

Choice labels waited as consequence verbs: name the absence method into Layer 8 pressure, or bargain with Pell while the rhyme still fit. Crownspire held its hush. Cufflink stillness. Perfume. Badge rewriting lobby hush into colder timeline. [player_name] felt the file watching her back as surely as Nolan did, and understood that reading it had already changed which soft she could still claim.
